prompt: With digit1, move tote_1 from the inbound_conveyor to line_feed. The job is done only when tote_1 is on line_feed and channel "line" has sent "RECEIVED": state both as the goal of the job.

paths.when: RECEIVED arrives from the line controller at 60 seconds
no message arrives: the final wait times out and the run fails

why: A message is not an end state of the world, so `message_received` is never in a `goal` (0043 S1, E327), and a goal is what Core receives (`export-goal`). "The job is done only when the line has sent RECEIVED" is written as a final bounded wait in the plan, with the world part in the goal (0043 C14): it is a program, not a decline. The program that puts the message in the goal is a 2.1 error.
